bdds.title: Reusable assessment rubric covers all mission assessment areas
bdds.given: a new ecommerce target is selected for assessment
bdds.when: an evaluator initializes the assessment rubric
bdds.then: the rubric requires evidence for search, autocomplete, browse navigation, filters/facets, recommendations/related discovery, mobile experience, and realistic product discovery journeys

bdds.title: Every finding is evidence-backed and business-readable
bdds.given: an evaluator records an assessment finding
bdds.when: the finding is saved or included in a report
bdds.then: it must include observation, evidence, severity, customer impact, business impact, and recommendation

bdds.title: Search evaluation tests query understanding, relevance, robustness, recovery, and effort
bdds.given: an ecommerce site search experience is assessed
bdds.when: the evaluator runs the search evaluation
bdds.then: the evaluation covers exact, partial, multi-word, attribute, category, brand, identifier, and long-tail queries along with precision, recall, ranking, diversity, coverage, typo tolerance, synonyms, abbreviations, zero-result recovery, latency, mobile usability, and interaction friction

bdds.title: Boxercraft pilot validates the framework without overfitting it
bdds.given: Boxercraft is used as the initial validation target
bdds.then: the output identifies Boxercraft-specific opportunities and records which rubric changes improve reuse for future ecommerce targets

bdds.title: Executive report answers leadership questions
bdds.when: an ecommerce, marketing, operations, or technology leader reads it
bdds.then: the report clearly states key findings, major strengths, major weaknesses, revenue-impacting opportunities, and recommended next steps without requiring technical search implementation knowledge

bdds.title: Scorecard produces explainable 0-100 product discovery scores
bdds.when: the Product Discovery Scorecard is produced
bdds.then: it scores Search, Autocomplete, Browse, Filters, Recommendations, Mobile Experience, and Product Discovery Overall from 0-100 with traceable rationale

bdds.title: Opportunity matrix classifies actionability and impact
bdds.given: findings have been scored and prioritized
bdds.then: each recommendation is classified as Quick Win, Strategic Improvement, or Transformational Opportunity with impact and effort rationale

bdds.title: Autocomplete evaluation measures suggestion quality and discovery support
bdds.given: an ecommerce autocomplete experience is assessed
bdds.when: the evaluator types representative customer queries
bdds.then: the evaluation captures query, product, category, and brand suggestions along with ranking, diversity, coverage, popularity bias, responsiveness, mobile usability, clarity, and discovery support

bdds.title: Browse and facet evaluation measures non-search findability
bdds.given: a customer journey does not use search
bdds.when: the evaluator navigates categories and filters
bdds.then: the evaluation captures hierarchy, naming clarity, navigation depth, grouping, completeness, mobile friction, facet relevance, facet organization, multi-select support, dead ends, persistence, and steps to locate products

bdds.title: Recommendation evaluation identifies related discovery opportunities
bdds.given: a product, category, or collection page exposes related discovery modules
bdds.then: the evaluation captures relevance, diversity, cross-sell opportunities, similar products, complementary products, seasonal products, and featured products

bdds.title: Journey analysis supports apparel, wholesale, and general retail scenarios
bdds.given: an evaluator prepares realistic customer journeys
bdds.when: the target vertical is apparel, wholesale, or general retail
bdds.then: the framework provides scenario templates for known-item search, attribute discovery, category browsing, SKU lookup, unavailable-item alternatives, comparison, and large-catalog navigation

bdds.title: Independent evaluator calibration produces similar findings
bdds.given: two evaluators assess the same ecommerce target using the framework
bdds.when: their findings and severities are compared
bdds.then: major findings, evidence requirements, and severity classifications are similar enough to support repeatable consulting use or the rubric records the calibration gap
bdds.defer_reason: Requires a completed pilot assessment and a second evaluator before reusable release.

bdds.title: Assessment records data freshness and access limits
bdds.given: assessment evidence is captured from public, authenticated, or client-supplied sources
bdds.then: the assessment records source, date, access context, known limitations, and whether the observation should be verified before client delivery

bdds.title: Client-facing report layout remains readable if PDF output is selected
bdds.given: the project generates a PDF or print-ready report
bdds.when: the report contains long finding text, tables, screenshots, and recommendations
bdds.then: text stays within safe margins, tables fit page width, headers and footers do not overlap content, and page breaks preserve readability
bdds.validation_notes: Northvalley LaTeX report and Beamer deck compiled successfully after rendered browser evidence updates. PDF text extraction found expected headings, page rendering produced non-empty PNG pages, and spot-checked pages were readable with no obvious overlap.
